title: Rice/Paddy — Harvest, Milling Recovery and Storage
content:
PADDY HARVEST:

MATURITY INDICATORS:
- 85-90% grains turn golden-yellow.
- Grain moisture: 20-22% (optimal for machine harvest), 25% for hand harvest.
- Days to maturity: Jyothi 115d, BPT-5204 135d, IR-64 125d.

HARVEST METHOD:
- Manual (sickle): Harvest at 25% moisture, bundle and thresh.
- Combine harvester: At 20-22% moisture. Adjust cylinder speed to avoid grain breakage.
- Avoid harvesting in rain — increases discoloration.

DRYING:
- Sun dry on clean tarpaulin to 14% moisture for milling.
- 12% moisture for long-term storage.
- Do not dry on road/mud — contamination and quality loss.
- Mechanical dryer: 40-45°C for best quality.

MILLING QUALITY:
- Harvest at right moisture (20-22%) for best milling recovery (65-68%).
- Late harvest causes chalkiness and breakage.
- Head rice recovery target: 55-60%.

STORAGE:
- Store in dry gunny bags or metal silos.
- Sealed hermetic bags (PUSA bins, PICS bags) for 0% loss.
- Fumigate with Aluminium Phosphide @ 3 tablets/tonne in sealed storage.
- Monitor for weevils (Sitophilus oryzae) — use grain protectants if needed.
- Target moisture: <14% for gunny bags, <13% for metal silos.

YIELD:
- Kharif (Jyothi): 5-6 t/ha paddy.
- Kharif (hybrid KRH-2): 7-8 t/ha.
- Rainfed: 3-4 t/ha.
- Milling ratio: 65-68% rice from paddy.
